title.purpose: Names the current workspace or inspected artifact.

label.purpose: Carries state, paths, commands, and telemetry.

shadows.name: floating-command
shadows.purpose: Only for temporary command surfaces and dragged artifacts.

motion.name: state-standard
motion.purpose: Focus, selection, expansion, and state feedback.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single decisive action in a workspace region.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { background:#E7A978; color:#191814; border:1px solid #E7A978; border-radius:6px; padding:10px 14px; font:600 11px/1.3 system-ui, sans-serif; transition:filter 180ms, transform 180ms, box-shadow 180ms; } .ds-button-primary:hover { filter:brightness(1.06); transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #191814, 0 0 0 4px #E7A978; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform:translateY(0); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: A quiet secondary action that remains easy to locate.
components.css: .ds-button-ghost { background:#211F1A; color:#F0E9DC; border:1px solid #3B382F; border-radius:6px; padding:10px 14px; font:600 11px/1.3 system-ui, sans-serif; transition:background 180ms, border-color 180ms; } .ds-button-ghost:hover { background:#2A2821; border-color:#AAA193; } .ds-button-ghost:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #E7A978; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-button-ghost:active { background:#191814; }

components.name: Command Field
components.description: Accepts natural-language direction without pretending to be chat.
components.html: <input class="ds-command-field" value="Give the stone shrine a colder silhouette" aria-label="Command" />
components.css: .ds-command-field { width:360px; box-sizing:border-box; background:#191814; color:#F0E9DC; border:1px solid #3B382F; border-radius:6px; padding:11px 12px; font:400 14px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; transition:border-color 180ms, box-shadow 180ms; } .ds-command-field:hover { border-color:#AAA193; } .ds-command-field:focus-visible { outline:none; border-color:#E7A978; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(231,169,120,.18); }

components.name: Live Status
components.description: Signals genuine active execution with text and a semantic mark.
components.css: .ds-status-live { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; background:#2A2821; color:#E7A978; border:1px solid #3B382F; border-radius:999px; padding:5px 9px; font:600 11px/1.3 system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Artifact Preview
components.description: The primary workspace stage for a generated artifact, with object/material modes and accessible camera controls.
components.css: .ds-artifact-preview { width:440px; margin:0; color:#AAA193; font:500 11px/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-artifact-preview figcaption { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; } .ds-artifact-preview figcaption span { color:#E7A978; } .ds-artifact-preview div { display:grid; place-items:center; aspect-ratio:16/9; margin-top:8px; background:#211F1A; color:#F0E9DC; border:1px solid #3B382F; border-radius:10px; } .ds-artifact-preview div:focus-visible { outline:none; border-color:#E7A978; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(231,169,120,.18); }

components.name: Workbench Panel
components.description: A persistent structural region, never a floating decorative card.
components.html:
Project memoryAncient coastal observatory

12 durable constraints shared with every agent.
components.css: .ds-workbench { width:300px; background:#211F1A; color:#F0E9DC; border:1px solid #3B382F; border-radius:10px; padding:18px; font:400 14px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-workbench small { display:block; margin-bottom:12px; color:#AAA193; font:600 11px/1.3 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-workbench strong { display:block; margin-bottom:6px; font-size:16px; } .ds-workbench p { margin:0; color:#AAA193; }

narrative.overview: Hexloom is a low-glare creative workspace for a solo creator working on a laptop in a warm room at night, shaping a world while a friend watches it take form. It feels like a carefully kept maker's desk: calm, tactile, personal, and visibly alive only when real work is happening.
keyCharacteristics: Warm and low-glare, never black, fluorescent, or clinical.
Asymmetric workspace composition with stable navigation.
Monospace reserved for paths, commands, and compact telemetry.
Visual energy produced by live, inspectable work.

rules.name: The Warm Hand Rule
rules.body: Clay Apricot occupies no more than ten percent of a screen; it marks creation and invitation, never generic system activity.

rules.name: The Signal Pair Rule
rules.body: Status color is always paired with an icon, label, or explicit state word.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Human guidance uses sans; machine identity, state, paths, commands, and telemetry use mono.

rules.name: The Bench Rule
rules.body: Persistent surfaces never float. If every panel casts a shadow, the hierarchy is wrong.

dos: Do reserve Clay Apricot for creative actions, focus, and the primary action.
Do connect every agent event to its originating intent and resulting artifact.
Do use asymmetric regions to establish priority while keeping navigation positions stable.
Do provide reduced-motion behavior and non-color state labels.
Do let genuine builds, tests, diffs, and generated previews create the spectacle.
donts: Don't create generic neon cyberpunk dashboards or use fluorescent color as decoration.
Don't use poisonous AI-green accents as the default sign of intelligence or activity.
Don't build fake walls of terminal noise or Matrix rain.
Don't arrange the workspace as identical SaaS card grids.
Don't add decorative AI animations that imply activity without explaining it.
Don't make Hexloom resemble a movie prop, a reskinned chat application, an observability dashboard, or an admin panel with green text.
Don't use colored side stripes, gradient text, or nested cards as visual shortcuts.
